channel.title: Understanding the Technology behind Blockchain
channel.description: A technical introduction to how blockchain works: cryptographic hash chains, Merkle trees, distributed consensus, and why Ethereum's programmable layer transformed a payments ledger into a platform for smart contracts and tokenised assets.
